name: Sujeeth
title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
headline: I build data systems and dashboards.
tagline: I began by building data warehouses, ETL workflows, dashboards, and large data migrations, then grew into analytics, data science, and cloud data engineering. Across varied business domains, I use SQL and Python to build data solutions with Azure, Databricks, AWS, Snowflake, and dbt, and translate findings into Tableau and Power BI dashboards. I partner with engineering, analytics, and business teams to make data accurate, understandable, and useful.
bio: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer with 10+ years of experience across data warehousing, ETL, migrations, dashboards, analytics, data science, and cloud engineering in varied business domains. I build and analyze data solutions with SQL, Python, Azure, Databricks, AWS, Snowflake, and dbt, and communicate insights through Tableau and Power BI. I work across engineering, analytics, and business groups to align technical solutions with different needs and make data reliable and useful.
